disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: Real activity is strong and broad: lobbying is exceptionally elevated at 3.5, pre-award solicitations are positive at 1.396, and regulatory, grant, and news signals are also positive across seven sources [P3]. Persistence is plausible but not yet proven because the theme is emerging [P1]; accelerating news, entirely unscheduled coverage, and several positive institutional signals support continuation [P3][P5], while congressional buying is negative and material 8-K activity is neutral [P3]. Price has not confirmed the activity: 60-day relative performance is weak, while the activity-price divergence is strongly positive at 2.152 [P2][P4]. That lag creates an early-entry setup rather than a confirmed trend, so confidence is medium [P1][P2][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号较强且来源较广：游说活动读数达3.5，招标前采购意向为1.396，监管、联邦资助和新闻信号也为正，共覆盖七类来源[P3]。持续性有一定依据但尚未得到充分证明，因为主题仍处于早期阶段[P1]；新闻流正在加速且全部为非计划性消息，多项机构活动同步转强[P3][P5]，但国会净买入为负，重大8-K事件没有增量[P3]。价格尚未确认这些变化：过去60天相对大盘表现偏弱，而现实活动领先价格的差距达到2.152[P2][P4]。因此这是活动先行、价格尚未跟上的早期介入机会，但确定性仅为中等[P1][P2][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Lobbying has surged, while procurement preparations, regulatory work, federal funding opportunities, and news activity are also picking up across several independent channels. Share prices have lagged the market over the past 60 days, so investors have not yet fully rewarded that improvement. This supports a measured early position, but the lack of corporate event activity and weak insider-policy buying make it prudent to wait for further confirmation before sizing aggressively.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 游说活动大幅升温，采购准备、监管推进、联邦资助机会和相关新闻也在多个相互独立的渠道中同步增加。相关公司股价过去60天落后于大盘，说明投资者尚未充分反映这些改善。可以考虑小规模提前布局，但企业重大事项没有增加，政策制定者相关买入也偏弱，因此不宜激进加仓。
assessments.dissent: The strongest contrary case is that the apparent surge is dominated by lobbying, while congressional net buying is negative, material 8-K events are flat, and prices are underperforming; the signal could therefore reflect advocacy and anticipation rather than durable commercial demand [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Over the next update window, pre-award solicitations, regulatory activity, grants, and news remain positive or strengthen, material 8-K events turn positive, and relative price performance improves from its current weakness [P3][P4][P5].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Lobbying falls sharply without follow-through from solicitations, grants, regulation, or material 8-K events, while relative price performance remains weak or deteriorates [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
assessments.name_zh: 半导体设备（晶圆厂设备）

assessments.rationale: Real activity is ahead of price, with a 1.232 divergence and positive fused acceleration across seven sources [P2][P3]. Strength is uneven: lobbying is exceptionally strong at z=3.5 and pre-award solicitations are positive at z=0.591, but material 8-K events, news flow, congressional buying, and grant opportunities are weak or negative [P3]. Durability is therefore uncertain, especially because news acceleration is negative despite elevated velocity and entirely unscheduled coverage [P5]. Price has not confirmed the activity signal: 60-day relative strength is negative, while the theme remains in a forming stage [P1][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动领先价格，活动与价格的背离为1.232，七类来源的综合加速度为正[P2][P3]。但信号分布不均：游说活动非常强，招标前需求也为正，而重大8-K事件、新闻流、国会净买入和拨款机会偏弱或为负[P3]。持续性仍不确定，因为新闻热度虽高，但增速正在下降，且全部来自非定期消息[P5]。价格尚未确认这一变化，过去60天相对大盘表现偏弱，主题仍处于形成阶段[P1][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Space-related lobbying and early-stage government solicitations are picking up, but contracts, grants, corporate disclosures and policymaker buying do not yet show broad support. Prices have lagged the market, so the activity may be arriving before investors have reacted, but slowing news momentum makes persistence uncertain. Keep watching rather than committing now, and look for contracts or corporate announcements to strengthen beyond lobbying.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 航天领域的游说活动和政府前期采购需求正在增加，但合同、拨款、公司重大公告和政策制定者买入尚未形成广泛支持。相关公司股价落后于大盘，说明现实活动可能早于市场反应，但新闻热度的增速正在放缓，持续性仍有疑问。现阶段宜继续观察，等待合同或公司公告出现更明确的改善。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that the 1.232 activity-price divergence, positive fused acceleration, exceptional lobbying ramp, and improving pre-award solicitations indicate an investable lead signal before weak relative price performance reverses [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the thesis if subsequent observations show positive acceleration persisting while federal contracts, pre-award solicitations, and material 8-K events turn jointly positive, followed by improving relative price strength [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the thesis if lobbying and pre-award activity weaken, fused acceleration turns negative, or price remains weak while news acceleration continues to fall [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Space Economy

assessments.rationale: Real activity is moderately positive but narrow: government-contract activity is strong at z=1.312, while congressional net buying (-0.421) and lobbying activity (-0.674) detract, and material 8-K events are neutral [P3]. The aggregate acceleration is strong at 1.414 across four sources [P3], but the signal is only forming [P1], the activity-price lead is modest at 0.194 [P2], and there is no supporting news leg [P5]. Price has not confirmed: the group trails the market by 5.74% over 60 days [P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号中等偏强但较集中：政府合同活动明显走强，但国会议员净买入和游说活动偏弱，重大8-K事件保持中性 [P3]。四类来源的综合加速度较强 [P3]，但信号仍在形成阶段 [P1]，活动领先价格的幅度有限 [P2]，且没有新闻面配合 [P5]。价格尚未确认，过去60天相对大盘落后5.74% [P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: 政府合同活动正在明显增加，但其他观察到的活动并未同步改善：国会议员净买入和游说活动偏弱，重大公司事件也没有增量。整体动能有所上升，但仍处于早期，而且没有新闻推动；与此同时，这组公司过去60天落后大盘约5.7%。目前更适合继续观察，等待更多活动来源转强或价格开始跟进，而不是立即买入。
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同活动明显增加，但其他方面尚未同步改善：国会议员净买入和游说活动偏弱，重大公司事件也没有明显增量。整体动能正在上升，但仍处于早期，也没有新闻推动；与此同时，这组公司过去60天落后大盘约5.7%。目前更适合继续观察，等待更多活动转强或价格开始跟进，而不是立即买入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish countercase is that aggregate activity acceleration is already high across four measured sources while price remains behind, creating potential upside if the early divergence broadens [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the narrative if subsequent readings show government-contract strength persisting while congressional buying, lobbying, or material-event activity also turns positive, accompanied by improving relative price performance [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the narrative if government-contract activity falls back without improvement in the other sources, especially if relative performance remains negative and no news support develops [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Communication Services (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: The current activity signal is mixed: congressional net buying is exceptionally strong, but lobbying is contracting and material 8-K events are only modestly positive; the combined acceleration is just 0.177 across three sources [P3]. Persistence looks weak because the theme is classified as fading, lobbying has fallen, and there is no supporting news leg [P1][P3][P5]. Price has already moved sharply ahead—60-day relative strength is 0.2766 with a 2.59 standardized reading—while the activity-versus-price divergence is -1.514, indicating negative divergence rather than activity leading price [P2][P4]. Avoid for now because the narrative appears priced beyond its underlying activity, despite the strong congressional signal [P1][P2][P3][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 当前活动信号好坏参半：国会议员净买入非常强劲，但游说活动正在收缩，重大8-K事件仅温和增加；三个来源合成后的加速度只有0.177 [P3]。持续性偏弱，因为主题已进入衰退阶段，游说活动下降，而且没有新闻支持 [P1][P3][P5]。价格已经明显跑在实际活动前面：过去60天相对大盘表现为0.2766，标准化读数为2.59，而活动相对价格的偏离值为-1.514 [P2][P4]。尽管国会议员买入信号突出，目前仍应回避，因为价格反映的乐观程度超过了基本活动的支撑 [P1][P2][P3][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government-linked buying has picked up sharply, but corporate event activity is only modestly stronger and lobbying activity is slowing. Prices have already risen substantially faster than the market even though the underlying activity is not strengthening at the same pace, and there is no supporting news momentum. The prudent course is to stay out for now and wait for broader, sustained improvement in real-world activity.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 与政府相关的买入活动明显增强，但企业重大事项只是温和增加，游说活动反而在放缓。相关公司的价格已经显著跑赢大盘，可现实活动并未同步增强，也缺少新闻面的持续推动。目前更稳妥的做法是暂时回避，等待多方面活动出现连续改善。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counterargument is that congressional net buying is extremely strong and material corporate events are positive across a three-source signal, so the weak combined reading could be an early-stage pickup that price has correctly anticipated rather than an exhausted narrative [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the view if subsequent observations show the combined activity acceleration rising materially, lobbying turning positive, and support broadening beyond congressional buying while price no longer outruns activity [P2][P3].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: The avoid call is reinforced if congressional net buying weakens, lobbying remains negative, combined acceleration falls below its current 0.177 level, or relative price strength stays elevated while the activity-price divergence remains negative [P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Non-AI Software

assessments.rationale: Real activity is mixed and presently weak: material 8-K events and congressional net buying are positive, but government-contract activity is sharply negative and lobbying is also declining across four sources [P3]. Durability is limited because the theme is classified as fading, while the small positive fused acceleration is not yet strong enough to overturn that signal [P1][P3]. Price has nevertheless outperformed the market over 60 days, creating a significant negative activity-versus-price divergence; without a supporting news leg, the narrative appears to be running ahead of its real-world evidence [P2][P4][P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动信号较弱且分化：重大8-K事件和国会议员净买入为正，但政府合同活动显著下降，游说活动也在减弱，四类来源并未形成一致支持 [P3]。该主题已进入衰退阶段，轻微的综合加速尚不足以扭转趋势 [P1][P3]。过去60天价格仍跑赢大盘，导致价格明显领先于真实活动，同时缺少新闻推动，说明当前叙事可能已经超前 [P2][P4][P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government-contract activity tied to the covered large technology companies has weakened sharply, and lobbying is also slowing, although regulatory filings and congressional buying provide some support. Their shares have still outperformed the market over the past 60 days, so prices appear to be running ahead of the underlying activity. With no fresh news catalyst and signs that momentum is fading, investors should avoid adding exposure until activity improves more consistently.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 这些大型科技公司的政府合同活动明显减弱，游说活动也在放缓，不过监管文件中的重大事项和国会议员净买入仍提供了一些支持。过去60天相关股价仍跑赢大盘，说明价格已经走在实际活动之前。由于缺少新的新闻催化，而且整体动能正在减退，投资者宜暂缓增加仓位，等待活动出现更一致的改善。
assessments.dissent: The strongest contrary case is that material-event activity is robust, congressional net buying is positive, fused acceleration remains slightly above zero, and price momentum is supportive; these may be early signs that the weak contract and lobbying readings are lagging rather than decisive [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the bearish judgment if the next observation still shows activity trailing price, with government-contract and lobbying signals remaining negative while the fading classification persists [P1][P2][P3].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if activity moves ahead of price and improvement becomes broad across multiple sources—especially a recovery in government contracts and lobbying—while positive acceleration persists rather than relying mainly on filings and congressional buying [P2][P3].

assessments.name: Magnificent Seven

assessments.rationale: Real activity is mixed: congressional net buying is exceptionally strong at 3.5 standard deviations and lobbying is rising, but government contracts, grant opportunities, material corporate events, and news flow are all below trend [P3]. Persistence looks doubtful because the theme is fading [P1] and news acceleration is negative despite elevated velocity and entirely unscheduled coverage [P5]. Price has outperformed the market over 60 days [P4], while the aggregate activity signal trails price [P2], suggesting investors have moved ahead of the underlying evidence. Monitor rather than enter until strength extends beyond congressional buying and lobbying.
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号分化：国会议员净买入异常强劲，游说活动也在上升，但政府合同、联邦资助机会、重大公司事件和新闻流均低于常态[P3]。持续性偏弱，因为主题已进入衰退阶段[P1]，且新闻热度虽然仍高，增速却在下降[P5]。价格过去60天跑赢大盘[P4]，但综合活动落后于价格[P2]，说明市场预期可能已经走在基本活动之前，因此目前更适合观察而非进场。
assessments.rationale_plain: Political buying and lobbying activity are rising, but government contracts, federal funding opportunities, major company events, and news coverage remain weak. News momentum is also slowing, while energy shares have already outperformed the broader market over the past two months. Investors should wait for improvement across more kinds of real-world activity before buying into the story.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政界买入和游说活动正在增加，但政府合同、联邦资助机会、重大公司事件和新闻报道仍然偏弱。与此同时，新闻热度正在降温，而能源股过去两个月已经跑赢大盘。投资者宜继续观察，等更多现实活动同步改善后再考虑进场。
assessments.dissent: The strongest opposing case is that congressional net buying is extremely elevated, lobbying is rising, aggregate acceleration remains modestly positive, and price leadership is already visible; these may be early signs that broader activity will follow [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the narrative if the next readings show government contracts, grants, material events, and news flow turning positive while aggregate activity moves ahead of price and news acceleration recovers [P2][P3][P5].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Avoid the narrative if congressional buying and lobbying weaken while aggregate activity remains behind price, news acceleration stays negative, and relative price strength reverses [P2][P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: US Energy Complex

rotation.summary: Leadership is rotating narrowly toward WFE, space, equal-weight communication services, and mature AI agents; only AI Agents is fully activity-confirmed, while the emerging leaders show activity leading price and most former growth, energy, health, and infrastructure themes are fading or confirmed down.
rotation.summary_zh: 领导力正狭窄轮动至半导体设备、太空经济、等权通信服务及成熟期AI智能体；仅AI智能体获真实活动完全确认，新兴方向由活动领先价格，而多数原增长、能源、医疗与基础设施主题正在衰退或已确认下行。
accumulate: AI Agents & Applications — CONFIRMED_UP, lifecycle=mature; real activity confirms the advance.
Semiconductor Equipment (WFE) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=emerging; activity leads price.
Space Economy — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=forming; activity leads price.
Communication Services (Equal-Weight) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=forming; activity leads price.
reduce: Non-AI Software; Magnificent Seven; US Energy Complex; Crypto & Digital Rails; equal-weight Energy, Technology, and Health Care; Big Pharma — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=fading; price is ahead of activity.
AI Neoclouds & HPC Hosting; Critical Minerals & Rare Earths; Nuclear & SMR Power; Regional Banks; Memory, HBM & Storage; Housing Chain — CONFIRMED_DOWN, lifecycle=fading.
GLP-1 & Obesity; Power & Grid Buildout; Travel & Experiences; Data-Center Power & Cooling — CONFIRMED_DOWN, lifecycle=fading.
watch: Whether positive-divergence WFE, Space Economy, and equal-weight Communication Services transition to CONFIRMED_UP; that would broaden and strengthen the new leadership.
Whether AI Agents & Applications loses CONFIRMED_UP or shifts from mature toward fading; that would remove the only fully confirmed leader.
Whether any NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE theme regains activity and turns CONFIRMED_UP, especially Magnificent Seven, equal-weight Technology, energy, or health care.
Whether QUIET adjacent themes such as AI Semiconductors, AI Infrastructure, AI Software & Platforms, Industrials, Reshoring, Defense, or Utilities develop positive divergence or confirmed-up states.
